svg.aria-label: How to make a Sherry Cobbler, step by step: Combine ingredients. Add the sherry, simple syrup and two orange half-wheels to your shaker. Shake. Add ice and shake hard. It's fine to bruise the orange a little. Strain over crushed ice. Fill a tall glass with crushed ice, and strain the drink over it. Garnish. Fresh berries, and a straw. (The straw is the whole point.) Cheers!
